## Summary

Fixed the search bug in `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`'s `search()` method. The old query built a single `where((q) => ...)` group that OR'd every keyword match together with `q.orWhere('published', true)` *inside the same parenthesized group* — this both (a) let unpublished posts back in whenever `published = true` matched any row regardless of keyword, and (b) OR'd the whole keyword-match clause against `published = true`, so it also padded results with unrelated published posts. I split it into two separate `where` calls: keyword OR-matching stays grouped in its own parens, and `.where('published', true)` is now a separate, always-applied AND condition — matching the pattern documented in `.claude/rules/orm-models.md`. Added regression tests in `tests/PostController.test.ts` (using `resetDatabase()`, `User.create`, and `Post.forceCreate`) covering: a shared-keyword case where only the published post is returned, and a keyword-only-in-an-unpublished-post case that returns an empty result. `bun run typecheck`, `bun test` (4/4 pass), and `bunx guren check` all pass.
